required_cases.container-cap-counts-every-kind: create-tenth-container, create-eleventh-container (one radar, one archived, seven custom)
required_cases.body-shapes: create-name-not-a-string, create-name-null, create-missing-name, create-array-body, create-string-body, create-null-body, create-empty-body, create-ignores-extra-fields

source_contracts: W02 commits the radar before reading its summary; a failed summary read is a 500 and the radar stays
W03 counts every container of the user, whatever its kind, against the limit of ten
W11 removes entries, targets and events explicitly; entries have no database cascade
not_scheduled: A concurrent request pair at the container cap: the runner pairs one expected status per actor, and the user-row lock serializes both stacks.
